record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.context_brief: Symbolic coding for Weyl chamber flow
record.original_question: Can analogs of geometric coding and arithmetic coding be constructed for the Weyl chamber flow, equivalently the diagonal group action, on SL(n,R)/SL(n,Z)?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 28 (S. Katok). Construct analogs of the geometric coding and the arith-metic codings for the Weyl chamber ﬂow (i.e., the action the d iagonal group) on SL(n, R)/SL(n, Z).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 2$ and consider the homogeneous space $X=\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb{R})/\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb{Z})$. Let $A\subset\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb{R})$ denote the subgroup of positive diagonal matrices (a maximal $\mathbb{R}$-split Cartan subgroup), and consider the Weyl chamber flow, i.e. the action of $A$ on $X$ by left translations.

For $n=2$, the geodesic flow on $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{R})/\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{Z})$ admits two classical symbolic codings of its closed orbits (equivalently, conjugacy classes of hyperbolic elements of $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{Z})$):
(i) the "geometric coding," obtained from a Bowen–Series / boundary-expansion construction associated with a fundamental domain for the Fuchsian group, producing a subshift whose sequences record successive sides of the fundamental domain crossed by the geodesic; and
(ii) the "arithmetic coding," obtained from Gauss's reduction theory of indefinite binary quadratic forms and the minus (or plus) continued fraction expansion, producing a sofic/Markov coding intrinsic to $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{Z})$.

Problem. Construct genuine analogs of the geometric coding and of the arithmetic coding for the Weyl chamber flow (the action of the full positive diagonal subgroup $A$) on $\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb{R})/\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb{Z})$ for $n\ge 3$. That is, produce symbolic systems (with explicit alphabets and admissibility rules) together with coding maps that conjugate the $A$-action (or a suitable cross-section of it) to these symbolic systems, generalizing the geometric and arithmetic codings known in the rank-one case $n=2$.
artifact.category_tag: Symbolic dynamics for higher-rank homogeneous flows
artifact.status_search_result: The problem, posed by S. Katok, asks for higher-rank analogs of the geometric and arithmetic codings she developed (with Ugarcovici) for the geodesic flow on the modular surface. Searches turn up extensive literature on the rank-one case and on rigidity of Weyl chamber flows (Damjanović–Katok and others), but no construction of geometric/arithmetic symbolic codings for the diagonal action on $\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb{R})/\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb{Z})$ for $n\ge 3$ appears in the available sources. The question seems to remain open.

status_evidence.snippet: Question 28 (S. Katok). Construct analogs of the geometric coding and the arithmetic codings for the Weyl chamber flow (i.e., the action of the diagonal group) on SL(n,R)/SL(n,Z).
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly posed as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Symbolic dynamics for the modular surface and beyond (S. Katok, I. Ugarcovici)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of geometric and arithmetic codings of the geodesic flow on SL(2,R)/SL(2,Z); higher-rank generalizations are not constructed.
status_evidence.claim: Coding techniques are developed only in the rank-one (modular surface) setting.

status_evidence.title: The Weyl chamber flow and applications (Hamenstädt)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses dynamics of Weyl chamber flows without providing a geometric or arithmetic symbolic coding for SL(n,R)/SL(n,Z).
status_evidence.claim: No symbolic coding analogous to the modular surface case is given.
